notes: Contradictions/unsupported in EXISTING page entry: (1) overview says AF 'causes one in five strokes'; CDC (retrieved) says about 1 in 7 strokes (US); I could not support one in five. (2) overview says 'hundreds of electrical impulses a minute swirl' and sinoatrial/atrioventricular node mechanism: not retrieved. (3) overview says sudden cardiac arrest and cognitive impairment/dementia: NHLBI does list these. (4) 'AF is not usually life-threatening' is consistent with NHS inform. (5) treatment text names digoxin, rate-limiting calcium-channel blockers, surgical approaches, stroke risk score components: not retrieved by me; the NHS retrieved lists calcium channel blockers, beta blockers, anti-arrhythmics. (6) diagnosis says ECG 'shows no P waves': not retrieved. (7) riskFactors 'Age over 65', 'Family history', 'Overweight' and causes 'Alcohol binges', 'Lung disease' not retrieved (NHS listed age, sex, smoking, some medicines, high BP, heart attack, CKD, overactive thyroid, diabetes, sleep apnoea). (8) seekCare 'urgent care' for palpitations with chest pain: NHS says 999. (9) signs 'pulse deficit' and 'low blood pressure' not retrieved (NHLBI lists low BP as a symptom). Search tool returned several summaries blending pages; claims assigned to NHS inform page types section are from summary of that page.
